two_hearts_scene: ^I'm just getting a nice lil fish here on this beautiful beach.
^It's not always about catching the fish *player*.
^It's about enjoying the beauty of the world.
^The fish will bite when they're ready, just have to be patient with them.
^But it's hard to be patient no?
^Especially for the things we desire so badly.
^Defintitely takes a lot of practice and discipline for sure.
^You have big dreams and a future to look forward to.
^That's why young people are so fun to watch for an old man like myself.
^You work hard for not only yourself, but for others too.
^You're very mature at a young age.
^Although I guess you are technically older than me no?
four_hearts_scene: ^I'm not sure I'm grinding on anything *player*
^Oh that's just an expression we used back on earth.
^Like your working hard to catch fish.
^Arno the other day called something "lit" and yet there was no light to be seen.
^And he also said we are "straight chillin" which made no sense because the temperature was pretty warm.
^I'll never quite understand all the expressions.
^I'll always try to learn and understand.
^And if I don't understand, I'll still accept you.
^The last thing you young kids need is a crochety old fart keeping you in the past.
^Plus the younger generations is who we need to understand and encourage more than anybody else.
^Lots of people my age really have a hard time understanding that.
^I remember when I was your age.
^The one thing I wanted more than anything was encouragement from my elders.
^It's interesting how time clouds our empathy.
^But I just want to let you know *player*.
^I will continue to support you until my days here are over.
six_hearts_scene: ^I was just about to have some dinner by the campfire tonight.
^Please come join and take a seat!
^Let me get you a breakfast burrito.
^It sure looks like your farm is coming around nicely.
^You've been plenty kind to me, so I must repay you.
^But I could never make them taste the way she made them.
^She was a wizard in the kitchen let me tell ya.
^She would always make them for me when I was feeling down.
^Because she knew when I was having a bad day.
^So *player*, anybody you got your eye on for marriage?

c-0: ^Actually I do have someone I think I want to marry.
^That sets my heart at ease knowing someone will care for you throughout the rest of your days.
c-1: ^I don't have anyone in mind yet.
^You'll know that person is the one so don't rush it.
^When you know that person is "the one", life gets more joyful.
^You both know each other inside and out.
^You know all their quirks and they know yours.
^You tell them the problems you face.
^The world may throw everything in its power towards you.
^But you will always have someone that is on your side.
^And you may annoy the daylights out of each other.
^When I met my Corinne, I knew immediately she was the one for me.
^I never had a dull moment with that woman.
^Whether you know who you want to marry or not *player*.
^Make sure they are your best friend.
^And never give up on them when times get tough ok?

eight_hearts_scene: ^Hey there *player* I'd like to show you something.
^This is where my dear Corinne and I met.
^Right here on this old bench years ago.
^I was sitting here alone when she sat right next to me.
^Do you mind if I sit here?
^You're like the prettiest girl in school.
^I saw you sitting here all alone on this bench and you look sad.
^I'm sorry stuff is just really hard right now.
^Oh no I don't want to give you the trouble.
^I really don't want to talk about it.
^I've had a really bad day too.
^Ahhh so now your asking about my bad day but I can't about yours.
^Only if you tell me what's wrong with you first.
^In a time where nobody else really was.
^My father hated me and I lost my beloved mother.
^For the first time in years, Corinne made me feel joy.
^It really felt like it was fate.
^We kept meeting each other on the same bench for weeks on end.
^She became the love of my life.
^We ended up getting married and had plans to start a family together.
^Would make a mess in the kitchen.
^And she would always make me her speciality breakfast burritos when I had a hard day.
^I would always get her flowers on her hard days.
^In the end, she would always get her way.
^When we realized she was pregnant we both shireked like little school girls.
^I was about to parent a child with the love of my life.
^I'm sorry Alex, but the complications were fatal.
^The child is in critical condition but doesn't have much time left.
^I think you should at least go see him.
^I only knew him for a couple hours.
^His name are the initials of Corinne and my mother.
^The two people that loved me the best.
^I not only lost my wife, but my beloved child at the same time...
^After Corinne and JC passed, I was a very angry and sad.
^I didn't understand why it had to be that way.
^I still don't get it to this day.
^During this time, I came around to a box hidden on Corinne's side of the bed.
^There was a note written in there if Corinne were to die before me.
^Because she knew I'd be lost without her.
^Inside this box was a necklace with a beautiful blue gemstone, a book, and a note.
^The note stated two wishes that she had.
^The first one was to read her favorite book.
^To ensure that we would end up in paradise together.
^The second wish was to give her necklace to somebody that I love dearly.
^Somebody that I know has a good heart.
^It was supposed to go to JC.
^I read the book within a week.
^And that book really gave me peace and hope.
^That one day I can see them again.
^It also taught me how to love others well.
^But the second wish I worried I'd never fulfill.
^I never thought that I could find a connection between a father and his child.
^You *player* have loved me as well as my Corinne did.
^I've watched you around town as well.
^You're everything I wanted JC to be.
^So please, take this necklace and use it for good.
^And I leave you with one request young friend.
^When I finally kick the bucket, bury me here with my family.
^So that I can rest with them.
^And hope that one day, there is somebody up there keeping my Corinne safe and playing with my little JC.
^And I get to join them in paradise.
^I'll love you until my last breath.
